title: Fisherman’s Life Charters
specs: Opportunities to catch Chinook and Coho salmon, lingcod, rockfish, BC spot prawns, and crabs
Wildlife sightings include humpbacks, orcas, migratory birds, and bald eagles
includes: All fishing gear, tackle, bait, and life jackets on board
blurb: Guests join expert guides for fishing adventures in the Pacific Ocean around Gabriola Island. The charters offer opportunities to catch various salmon, lingcod, rockfish, spot prawns, and crabs. Wildlife such as humpbacks, orcas, migratory birds, and bald eagles can be seen during trips.
extraNote: Minimum 4 hour booking · Pages Resort & Marina on Gabriola Island
